## A vacation on Usedom means variety

You want to go swimming, but you also want to go sightseeing. Of course, you want to enjoy yourself and relax—but without getting bored! Is sports your lifeblood? Or nature? That works out perfectly, because the Baltic Sea island of Usedom is so diverse that you have plenty of options.

- [Special Features](https://usedom.de/en/island/specialties)
- [Places](https://usedom.de/en/island/towns-und-villages)
- [History & Traditions](https://usedom.de/en/island/history-and-traditions)

## Heringsdorf Castle Apartments

- Modernly furnished apartments, designed with an eye for detail and some offering ocean views, provide everything your heart desires for a vacation.
- A unique location on the Kulm hill with views of the seaside resort architecture and the Baltic Sea.
- Comfortable accommodations ranging from simple to luxurious—the Schloßappartements Heringsdorf.
- An on-site restaurant at the Hotel Weißes Schloß and a castle bar featuring over 120 varieties of gin

## Your Vacation with a Seaside Twist

Our beach paradise in the Bay of Pomerania has plenty to offer that will delight any vacationer. Starting with the 42-kilometer-long [sandy beach](https://usedom.de/en/experience-usedom/beach-and-swimming) along the Baltic Sea coast. Plus, there are [places](https://usedom.de/en/island/towns-und-villages) worth visiting—some idyllic, others steeped in history. [Leisure activities](https://usedom.de/en/plan-vacation/book-leisure-activities) for the whole family and [culinary delights](https://usedom.de/en/experience-usedom/cuisine) that will leave you wanting more. Because Usedom is more. More than the sum of its attractions, more than the number of hours of sunshine.

### Usedom has many colors

Usedom is air. So clear that you can breathe deeply and feel liberated. And light—so radiant, it’s as if someone had just cleaned your glasses. Usedom is color. Above all, the interplay of blue and white between the Baltic Sea and the beach, the sky and the little clouds. Green like untouched meadows, gnarled dune pines, and ancient beech trees. And, of course, golden yellow like our greatest treasure: [amber](https://usedom.de/en/island/special-features/amber). With a few tips, you can even find it along Usedom’s coast.

![A couple is standing in a green coastal forest.](https://usedom.de/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbackend.usedom.de%2Fsites%2Fdefault%2Ffiles%2F2023-04%2Fwandern-im-kuestenwald-koserow-copyright-martiem-fotografie.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

MarTiem Photography©

Hiking in the Koserow Coastal Forest

### Space for Your Vacation Dreams

Let your gaze wander across the sea to the horizon: On Usedom, there’s plenty of space to make your vacation dreams come true. For example, along the 12-kilometer-long [beach promenade](https://usedom.de/en/plan-vacation/tours-und-activities/beach-promenade) of the imperial resort towns. It connects Germany with Poland and is famous for its stately [coastal architecture](https://usedom.de/en/island/special-features/seaside-resort-architecture). Or on the trails through [Usedom Island Nature](https://usedom.de/en/experience-usedom/nature-und-activities/nature-park) [Park](https://usedom.de/en/experience-usedom/nature-und-activities/nature-park), which is so important for Usedom’s unique flora and fauna.
